title: Q1 strategy hatch and exec brief - planning slate
body:
Purpose
--------
This is an early-stage planning slate intended to surface a tight set of candidate company-level objectives for Q1, surface known risks and trade-offs, and propose a short, pragmatic All-Hands agenda to align org energy before the official OKR kickoff. Treat as a hatch: idea-first, low ceremony, flagged questions for execs.

TL;DR
------
- Primary focus candidate: tighten product SLAs + lower per-token cost for hosted inference without regressing output quality (2x ops efficiency target).
- Secondary: launch Redwood Private pilot (2 customers) with hardened on-prem install & audit checklist.
- All-Hands proposed 90-minute slot: state, 3 cross-functional asks, breakout rooms for team-level commitments.

Proposed Company Objectives (candidate)
-------------------------------------
Objective A: Make inference predictable and cheaper for scale customers
- KR A1: Reduce average cost-per-token for the 90th percentile production workloads by 18% vs. baseline (Dec runbook).
- KR A2: Decrease p95 tail latency for hosted API by 30ms for 1–5k token requests.
- KR A3: Ship automated batching + prefix-caching config suggestions with adoption in 3 major customers.

Objective B: Enterprise-ready Private deployments (security + reliability)
- KR B1: Complete Private VPC onboarding playbook and KMS integration with two pilot customers.
- KR B2: Achieve Private deployment install success rate >= 85% on first attempt in pilot.
- KR B3: Add audit log export and 90-day retention option in Console.

Objective C: Developer velocity and observability
- KR C1: Deliver per-route token cost breakdown in Console (beta).
- KR C2: Reduce mean time to detect a model quality regression from 48h to 8h via prompt-set evals.

All-Hands draft agenda (90 minutes)
----------------------------------
0–10m: Opening + context (CEO) — short narrative: why inference economics matters this year
10–30m: Product state (SVP Product) — 3 wins, 3 gaps, demo of Console cost view beta
30–45m: Customer panel (recorded clips) — 2 customers on Dedicated and one on Private pilot
45–60m: Exec asks (ops/product/eng) — 3 cross-functional asks with explicit owners
60–80m: Breakouts by functional pods — commit 1-2 team-level actions for Q1 OKRs
80–90m: Close + next steps + where to sign up for working groups

Exec asks (starter list)
-----------------------
- Eng-serving-runtime: commit to a prioritized 6-week latency sprint focusing on attention kernel hotspots. Owner: Marta Lopez.
- Product/Console: ship per-route cost beta by Jan 20 and enable a limited opt-in for customers. Owner: Ethan Chu.
- Solutions/SE: line up two Private pilot customers and document install lessons in the playbook. Owner: Samira Khan.

Decision radar (risks, trade-offs, signals)
-----------------------------------------
Risk: Aggressive cost reductions could create quality regressions.
- Signal to watch: evaluation regression > 2% on internal prompt-sets or >5% for any logged customer prompt cluster.
- Mitigation: automatic rollback path and regression alert to owners; hold back 10% of traffic for canary for any quantization change.

Trade-off: dedicating Eng SRE cycles to Private installs vs. investing more in hosted autoscaling improvements.
- Guiding principle: prioritize customer commitments tied to revenue + long-term strategic wins (Private for regulated verticals).

Dependencies
------------
- Release engineering: packaging and infra images for Private by Dec 20.
- Compliance/Security: finalize audit checklist for pilot (data flows, KMS) by Jan 7.
- Bizops: finalize pricing guidance for Dedicated discounts and Private licensing by Jan 10.

Preliminary timeline and milestones
----------------------------------
Nov 8–Dec 15: Strategy hatch refinements, exec feedback loop, validate KRs with GTM and Finance
Dec 16–Jan 10: Freeze final company OKRs and publish starter team-level templates
Jan 12: Company kickoff + All-Hands (execute 90-minute slate)
Jan 13–Mar 31: Execution quarter; weekly cross-functional sync and health dashboard

Open questions (need exec input)
------------------------------
- Q1 budget levers: how much committed headroom for Dedicated capacity procurement are we comfortable with? (Finance ask)
- Can we accept a temporary (one-quarter) SLA variance for select low-revenue models while we optimize cost? (CS + Sales input)
- What threshold triggers a full stop on quantization rollout if regressions appear? (Product + Research)

Next steps (owners + short actions this week)
--------------------------------------------
- Ravi: consolidate feedback from execs; propose final set of 3 company objectives by Nov 22.
- Marta: run scope doc for latency sprint and resource ask by Nov 18.
- Ethan: demo Console beta to leadership and share adoption plan by Nov 20.
- Samira: confirm 2 pilot customers and draft install checklist by Nov 30.

Notes / context fragments
------------------------
